correctness.rationale: Independent symmetric-coordinate multinomial expansion gives E(S^6)=15+15(t-3)sum a_i^4+(t^2-15t+30)sum a_i^6 at sum a_i²=1. For every pair of squared coefficients of fixed sum, the objective is affine in the pair product with signed coefficient -2A-3Bs, proving strict balancing/deletion or exact flat degeneracy. An unequal positive pair at t in (3,5) cannot coexist with a third positive weight at a maximizer; at t=5 every one/two-support split ties, and t>5 one support is forced. Adjacent differences have a strictly monotone parameter ratio, yielding all crossings and their order; the continuous envelope yields the Gaussian transition and 75/8 second-order asymptotic. Packaged checker independently passed exact multinomial, symbolic, rational grid, threshold and degeneracy diagnostics; finite checks are not used to infer the universal quantifiers.
